explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1005: is there c>0 with f(n)=(c+o(1))n? f is defined as the minimum number of Farey fractions strictly between a non-similarly-ordered pair, which equals (smallest bad index gap)-1, the page's 'largest f(n)' condition. Negative product is the complement of (a_k-a_l)(b_k-b_l)≥0. The empty sInf for n<4 does not affect the limit. Limit of f(n)/n to c>0 is the requested asymptotic.
